name: Legacy user API key
description: A user API key, the former Airtable API credential, whose deprecation period ended on 1 February 2024.

blockers.summary: No Airtable page read states a prefix, alphabet or length for the former user API key.
Only an issued legacy key would show its format, and none can be issued after 2023-08-01.
